title: skills: encode the maintainer's axis-weighting ruling into the four-axis decision framework — long-term soundness carries the highest weight, at least 50%
body:
Maintainer ruling, 2026-09-01, PM chat channel (director seat decision batch, on the #13331 presentation), verbatim:

> 四维分析中，长期合理应该权重最高，至少50%

## What to encode

The four-axis decision framework (single source: pm-dispatch SKILL.md 「升级与决策」, serialized as the 四棱 card block; details in `references/decision-analysis.md`) currently treats the four axes as co-equal inputs with a tie-break order (2026-08-27 「分歧推荐序按拉动定向」). This ruling adds an explicit weighting: **项目长远合理性 (long-term soundness) carries the highest weight — at least 50% — when axes conflict.** Recommendations must lead with the long-term reading, and the other three axes together cannot outvote it.

## Boundaries

- This composes with, not replaces, the 2026-08-27 tie-break ruling and the standing human-floor items (安全/权限边界、破坏性难逆动作恒在人工地板 — unchanged).
- Frame-sync discipline applies: the four-axis framework has `check:skill-frame-sync`-managed copies — all copies move together in one PR.
- Skills lane owns the edit; the landing PR is governed (`.claude/**`) — draft-only, human merge. Mind the SKILL.md line ratchet: prefer landing the weighting in `references/decision-analysis.md` (outside the ratchet) with the main file unchanged if it fits no ratchet budget.

Filed by the director seat, session `session_015adLit3ZYASJiXwxKG78Wi`. Routing/grading is triage's.
